attempts.surface: TPT Work Skills management iframe and round-owned standard/low chat via CDP 9234 + Playwright

actual_preconditions.project: existing project; no new project created

attempts.input: Explicitly invoke the selected round-owned Skill and generate 600 numbered neutral productivity reminders; no tools, files or external resources.
actual_steps: Verified the only target Skill switch was enabled=true in the management iframe.
Clicked its UI quick-use entry, retained the slash Skill selector, entered the neutral long task in the visible chat composer, and sent through the UI.
After send, observed the session Stop control visible, switched back to the Skills iframe and toggled only this round-owned Skill true to false.
Returned to the session row and observed the ????? status while the Skill was disabled.
Polled the active session until the Stop control disappeared and the transcript showed an assistant response; recorded the transcript boundary and noted that only an initial segment was visible.
Restored the target Skill switch to true in the Skills UI and read it back.
attempts.wait_condition: Wait until the session is no longer active; observe in-flight status immediately after the off toggle and check state restoration.

checkpoints.expected: 当前任务不被开关终止
checkpoints.observed: After the target Skill was toggled off, the task remained visibly ?进行中?; a later poll showed no active Stop control and an assistant response in the transcript. This supports that it was not stopped immediately by the switch. Only the initial visible segment (about 35 reminders) was observed, so the requested 600-item output was not verified.

checkpoints.expected: 后续自动发现遵循新状态

attempts.observed_result: Through UI quick-use, explicitly selected the round-owned long sample and sent the neutral 600-reminder task in the standard/low workspace. Stop was visible after send. In the Skills iframe, toggled only this sample from true to false while the session row still showed ?进行中?. After returning to the session, the active indicator was still present; a later poll had no Stop control and the transcript showed a final assistant response. The visible response only showed an initial short segment (about 35 reminders) and did not prove all 600. The later-task discovery checkpoint was not separately tested.
